repos.description: 《Hello 算法》：动画图解、一键运行的数据结构与算法教程。支持简中、繁中、English、日本語，提供 Python, Java, C++, C, C#, JS, Go, Swift, Rust, Ruby, Kotlin, TS, Dart 等代码实现
repos.summary_zh: 《Hello 算法》是一本开源免费的数据结构与算法教程，采用动画图解显著降低学习门槛，支持12+编程语言一键运行代码。覆盖简中、繁中、英文、日文，适合编程新手与面试准备者，通过可视化与实操结合高效提升算法思维与工程实现能力。
repos.summary_en: Hello Algo is a free open-source tutorial that demystifies data structures and algorithms through animated visualizations and interactive code execution. Supporting 12+ programming languages and four human languages, it offers smooth learning curves with visual explanations and hands-on practice. Ideal for beginners and interview candidates, it effectively bridges theory with implementation to build algorithmic thinking.

repos.description: Turn any idea, plan, or codebase into a beautiful interactive diagram. An agent skill for Claude Code, Codex, and more.
repos.summary_zh: Archify 是一款 AI 代理技能工具，能将自然语言描述转化为精美的架构图、工作流图、序列图、数据流图和生命周期图。生成自包含 HTML，支持暗/亮主题一键切换、剪贴板复制及最高 4 倍原生分辨率导出（PNG/JPEG/WebP/SVG）。SVG 支持系统主题偏好。集成 Claude 等平台，无需设计技能，通过聊天指令迭代优化。核心价值是提升技术文档和可视化效率，适用于系统架构、DevOps 流程及数据管道等场景。
repos.summary_en: Archify is an agent skill for AI tools like Claude that generates high-quality architecture, workflow, sequence, data-flow, and lifecycle diagrams from plain English text. It outputs self-contained HTML files featuring instant dark/light theme toggles, clipboard PNG copy, and native 4× resolution exports in PNG, JPEG, WebP, or SVG. SVGs include dual themes with media queries for automatic adaptation. Requiring no design expertise, it supports conversational refinements and is ideal for technical documentation, system design, CI/CD pipelines, and data engineering visualizations.

repos.description: Editorial diagram design for Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Factory Droid, Qoder, and Pi. 45 diagram types. Self-contained HTML + SVG. No shadows. No Mermaid slop.
repos.summary_zh: 专为Claude Code、Codex、Pi等AI智能体打造的编辑级图表技能。输出纯自包含HTML+SVG，无阴影、无Mermaid粗糙样式，支持架构、流程、序列、Sankey、Wardley等数十种专业类型。可读取网站自动匹配品牌色与字体，默认静态输出，可选无障碍动画，并能重绘draw.io/Mermaid/Excalidraw源图。强调极简密度与焦点设计，让AI生成图表真正达到设计师水准。
repos.summary_en: Editorial diagram skill for Claude Code, Codex, Pi and Agent Skills hosts. Produces self-contained HTML+SVG with no shadows or Mermaid-style clutter. Supports architecture, flowcharts, sequences, Sankey, Wardley maps and dozens more types. Auto-matches brand colors/fonts from your site in seconds. Static by default with optional accessible motion; redraws draw.io, Mermaid or Excalidraw sources. Delivers clean, designer-approved visuals with deliberate low density and focal accents.

repos.description: A Python library for extracting structured information from unstructured text using LLMs with precise source grounding and interactive visualization.
repos.summary_zh: LangExtract是Google开源的Python库，基于LLM实现非结构化文本的结构化信息抽取。核心亮点：精确溯源定位、支持长文档并行处理、交互式HTML可视化、兼容云/本地模型，通过few-shot示例定义领域任务，无需微调即可适配临床笔记、报告等多场景。
repos.summary_en: LangExtract is Google's open-source Python library for structured information extraction from unstructured text using LLMs. Key features: precise source grounding, long document optimization via parallel processing, interactive HTML visualization, flexible cloud/local model support, and domain adaptation through few-shot examples without fine-tuning.

repos.description: Beautiful map components. 100% Free, Zero config, one command setup.
repos.summary_zh: mapcn 是一个免费开源的 React 地图组件库，提供零配置、一键集成的地图解决方案。基于 MapLibre GL 构建，深度集成 Tailwind CSS 和 shadcn/ui 样式体系，支持主题感知、可组合组件、标记弹窗、路线绘制等核心功能，适用于快速开发美观的地图可视化应用。
repos.summary_en: mapcn is a free, open-source React map component library that provides zero-config, one-command setup for beautiful map visualizations. Built on MapLibre GL and styled with Tailwind CSS, it seamlessly integrates with shadcn/ui design patterns. Key features include theme-aware light/dark mode adaptation, composable map components, rich markers with popups and tooltips, route/path drawing capabilities, and built-in controls—enabling rapid development of sophisticated map-based applications.

repos.description: Open-source intelligence for the global theater. Track everything from the corporate/private jets of the wealthy, and spy satellites, to seismic events in one unified interface. Hook an AI agent up to have it parse through data and find previously unseen correlations. The knowledge is available to all but rarely aggregated in the open, until now.
repos.summary_zh: ShadowBroker是实时多域开源情报平台，聚合60+公开数据源包括航班ADS-B、船舶AIS、卫星遥测及地震信息。基于Next.js与MapLibre GL构建交互式地图，支持35+数据层切换与右键地理情报查询。采用自托管架构确保隐私，面向分析师提供全球威胁监控与研究工作。
repos.summary_en: ShadowBroker is a real-time OSINT platform aggregating 60+ public data sources including aircraft ADS-B, maritime AIS, satellite telemetry and seismic events. Built with Next.js and MapLibre GL, it provides 35+ interactive data layers and geospatial analysis tools. Self-hosted deployment ensures privacy for analysts tracking global threats and conducting open-source intelligence research.

repos.description: Generate beautiful dark-themed system architecture diagrams as standalone HTML/SVG files. Works as a Claude AI skill.
repos.summary_zh: 通过Claude AI技能，将自然语言描述自动转换为专业深色主题架构图。输出独立HTML文件，无需设计工具，支持实时迭代修改。适用于系统设计评审、技术文档可视化，显著提升架构沟通效率与团队协作体验。
repos.summary_en: The Architecture Diagram Generator is a Claude AI skill that automatically converts natural language descriptions into professional, dark-themed system architecture diagrams. It outputs self-contained HTML files that can be opened in any browser without specialized software. Users can easily iterate on designs through conversational prompts, adding components or adjusting layouts instantly. This tool is ideal for system design reviews, technical documentation, and architecture presentations, dramatically improving communication efficiency and team collaboration while eliminating the need for manual diagramming tools and design expertise.

repos.description: Agent skills and an AI-native SwiftUI component library for iOS apps: animations, Metal shaders, charts, components and full-stack modules your coding agent can build from.
repos.summary_zh: ShipSwift 是一个 AI 原生的 SwiftUI 组件库，提供生产就绪的动画、图表、UI 组件和全栈模块配方。通过 MCP 服务器或本地技能安装，AI 工具如 Claude、Cursor 可即时获取代码与上下文，快速构建真实 iOS 应用。兼容 30+ AI 编码助手，含可搜索目录和 App Store 展示 App，还提供自定义开发服务。适用于加速原生 iOS 开发与 AI 辅助编程。
repos.summary_en: ShipSwift is an AI-native SwiftUI component library providing production-ready components and full-stack recipes for animations, charts, UI elements, and modules. Via MCP server or local skills, AI tools like Claude and Cursor instantly access code and context to build real iOS apps. Compatible with 30+ AI coding assistants, it includes a searchable catalog, App Store showcase app, and custom development services. Accelerates native iOS development with AI assistance for Swift 5.0+ and iOS 18+.

repos.summary_zh: 这是一个基于大语言模型的知识图谱自动生成系统。它将非结构化文本解析为'主-谓-宾'三元组，通过实体标准化和关系推理构建结构化知识网络，并生成交互式可视化。系统支持任何OpenAI兼容的LLM API（如Ollama、vLLM），提供文本分块、实体消歧、关系推断等完整流水线，适用于文档知识挖掘、研究资料整理等场景。核心价值在于将海量文本转化为可探索的语义网络，实现知识的直观呈现与深度关联分析。
repos.summary_en: This is an automated knowledge graph generation system powered by Large Language Models. It processes unstructured text by extracting Subject-Predicate-Object triplets via LLMs, then constructs structured knowledge networks through entity standardization and relationship inference. The system produces interactive visualizations and supports any OpenAI-compatible API endpoints (Ollama, vLLM, cloud services). Key features include text chunking, entity resolution, transitive inference, and configurable pipelines. It transforms textual information into explorable semantic networks, enabling deep knowledge discovery and visual analytics for research and document analysis.

repos.description: AI deep-research agent that turns any question into a cited report: plans searches, reads real sources, verifies evidence. Self-hosted, multi-provider, Docker-ready.
repos.summary_zh: 基于深度研究的AI助手，通过迭代搜索与LLM实现自动化信息挖掘。支持DeepSeek R1等主流模型，提供树状可视化研究流程与实时流式反馈。采用浏览器本地化处理确保数据安全，集成Tavily/Firecrawl多源搜索。支持PDF导出与Docker部署，适用于学术研究、市场分析等深度调研场景。
repos.summary_en: An AI-powered research assistant that automates deep information gathering through iterative search and LLM reasoning. Features real-time streaming feedback and tree-structured visualization of research processes. Supports DeepSeek R1 and major LLM providers with local browser processing for data privacy. Integrates Tavily and Firecrawl for web search, offers PDF export, Docker deployment, and server mode. Ideal for academic research, market analysis, and competitive intelligence requiring comprehensive, automated investigation with full citation tracking.

repos.description: ML algorithms implemented and derived from first-principles in Jupyter Notebooks and NumPy
repos.summary_zh: 该项目通过 Jupyter Book 和 Marimo 构建交互式机器学习可视化平台，核心价值在于从第一性原理出发，使用 NumPy 纯 Python 实现神经网络、逻辑回归、PCA 等核心算法并配套数学推导。动态可视化训练过程，直观展示权重变化对损失函数的影响，是理解算法内部机制的顶级教学工具。
repos.summary_en: This project builds an interactive ML visualization platform using Jupyter Book and Marimo. It implements core algorithms—neural networks, logistic regression, PCA, etc.—from first principles with NumPy, accompanied by mathematical derivations. Dynamic visualizations show training progression and weight-loss relationships, serving as a premier educational tool for understanding algorithmic internals.

repos.summary_zh: Isoflow 是基于 React 的开源网络图绘制组件，提供拖放编辑器、可扩展图标系统（支持 AWS/Azure 等云插件）和代码/图片导出功能。作为 MIT 许可的开源核心项目，社区版适用于 IT 基础设施可视化、云架构设计与网络拓扑规划场景。技术亮点在于灵活的插件机制与 React 组件的易集成性，助力快速构建专业网络文档。
repos.summary_en: Isoflow is an open-source React component for drawing network diagrams. It features a drag-and-drop editor, extensible icon system with plugins for AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, and export options to code or images. As an MIT-licensed open-core project, the Community Edition is ideal for architecture visualization, infrastructure planning, and network topology scenarios. Highlights include plugin extensibility and seamless React integration.

repos.description: AetherViz Master - 互动教育可视化建筑师，将任意教学主题转化为沉浸式3D交互网页
repos.summary_zh: AetherViz Master 是一款 AI 驱动的互动教育可视化工具，能将任意教学主题一键转化为沉浸式 3D 交互网页。支持物理、化学、生物、数学等多学科，自动识别领域并匹配最佳渲染方案。核心价值在于零代码生成专业教学页面，集成 Three.js 3D 引擎、SVG 混合渲染、KaTeX 公式及 OrbitControls 交互。适用于教师、学生和内容创作者，通过 Claude 等 AI 助手实现快速沉浸式学习内容创作，提供粒子系统、测验面板和响应式玻璃拟态 UI。
repos.summary_en: AetherViz Master is an AI-powered interactive educational visualization tool that instantly converts any teaching topic into immersive 3D interactive web pages. It supports subjects like physics, chemistry, biology, and math with automatic domain recognition and optimal rendering selection. Core value lies in zero-code generation of professional teaching pages using Three.js 3D engine, hybrid SVG rendering, KaTeX formulas, and OrbitControls. Ideal for teachers, students, and creators, it integrates with AI assistants like Claude for rapid immersive content creation, featuring particle systems, quizzes, and responsive glassmorphism UI.

repos.description: A golang implementation of endlessh (SSH tarpit) exporting Prometheus metrics, visualized by a Grafana dashboard.
repos.summary_zh: 基于Go实现的SSH tarpit（endlessh），通过故意延迟响应浪费暴力破解攻击者时间，并导出Prometheus指标，配合Grafana仪表板可视化攻击源地理位置与统计数据。适用于SSH安全防护与威胁情报场景，支持Docker部署、GeoIP查询、健康检查，轻量高效且可观测性强。
repos.summary_en: A Golang implementation of endlessh (SSH tarpit) that delays responses to waste brute-force attackers' time while exporting Prometheus metrics, visualized via a Grafana dashboard showing geolocations and attack statistics. Ideal for SSH defense and threat intelligence, with Docker support, GeoIP lookup, and health checks.

repos.description: ✨❤️‍🔥Turn the cities you love into stunning designs
repos.summary_zh: MapPoster Online 是一款基于浏览器的地图艺术生成工具，无需安装即可将全球城市地图转化为精美海报。采用 React 19 与 TypeScript 构建前端界面，Rust WASM 处理地图渲染，Bun 作为高性能运行时。支持亚洲、欧洲、美洲等数十个热门城市，提供即时预览与高清导出，是旅行纪念与城市美学创作的理想选择。
repos.summary_en: MapPoster Online is a browser-based map art generator that transforms city maps into stunning posters without installation. Built with React 19 and TypeScript, it leverages Rust WASM for map rendering and Bun as the high-performance runtime. Supporting dozens of cities across Asia, Europe, and the Americas, it offers instant preview and HD export, ideal for travel memorabilia and urban aesthetic creation.

repos.summary_zh: Austen是一款AI驱动的文学分析工具，通过集成DeepSeek/OpenAI自动解析书籍角色关系，并生成Mermaid可视化图谱。基于Next.js全栈框架与Supabase后端，支持用户管理、图表保存(SVG/PNG)与社交分享，为教育、阅读及文学研究提供直观的关系探索体验。
repos.summary_en: Austen is an AI-powered literary analysis tool that automatically extracts character relationships from books using DeepSeek/OpenAI and visualizes them via Mermaid diagrams. Built on Next.js fullstack with Supabase backend, it enables user management, graph export (SVG/PNG), and social sharing—ideal for educators, readers, and literary research to visually explore narrative dynamics.
